verdict.rationale: Ollama is a model runtime and cloud API platform, so outbound event webhooks are a fair question for it, but the evidence pack never documents registrable webhook callbacks. The REST API is request/response only, and the OpenClaw messaging integrations (WhatsApp, Slack, Discord) are chat-app connections, which do not count as webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
